# Float

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Language Features](Language-Features) · [Types](Language-Features-Types)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Float(value)
Float:Float32(value)
```

## Description

Converts a number or a text to a float. Integers are not divided with a fraction (`7 / 2` is 3), so convert one side first.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print 7 / 2
Print Float(7) / 2
Print Float("1.5") + 1
```

```text
3
3.5
2.5
```
